notes: Store protocol mapping to dossier 06: read-only immutable values + explicit copy-on-use (fresh bytes every read; mutable-array publish discipline documented for layers above); per-key single-flight (atomic-content locks, dead-holder recovery, token-matched release); bounded memory LRU INERT without a positive max_memory_bytes + bounded disk quota eviction by touched atime; writers stage+fsync+atomic dir-rename commit manifests; readers verify sizes always and checksums per policy before use; corruption = quarantine + miss; non-executable formats (raw bytes only, no pickle anywhere; allow_pickle=False discipline documented for the array layer); traversal guards on keys AND manifest-declared payload names; ejection never invalidates in-flight readers.
